Forest Frame Calendar (Plantable) – Eco-Friendly Desk Calendar with Seed-Paper Sheets

The Forest Frame Calendar (plantable) Eco-Friendly product is a premium sustainable desk accessory designed for conscious consumers and brands who value green gifting. Made with 12 Seed-Paper Sheets (3.5″x5″), this reusable and plantable calendar offers a thoughtful blend of natural materials and modern design. Each page is crafted using biodegradable seed paper that transforms into herbs or flowers when planted, making it a perfect choice for eco-friendly gifts and high-quality sustainable corporate gifts.

The calendar features a durable Metal Ring Bound structure that allows smooth flipping of monthly sheets, while the beautiful preserved moss frame on a 6″x6″ MDF base adds a refreshing, forest-themed aesthetic to any desk, workspace, or reception area. Since the preserved moss requires no watering or maintenance, it gives a natural and earthy look throughout the year without environmental impact.

This eco desk calendar comes with complete instructions included, making it easy for users to understand how to plant the seed paper once each month is completed. It promotes sustainable living, reduces paper waste, and supports reforestation concepts by turning every month into a small green contribution. Ideal for personal use, employee welcome kits, corporate gifting, events, and eco-friendly promotional campaigns, this plantable calendar stands out as a meaningful and responsible gifting choice.

Why Choose the Forest Frame Calendar (Plantable) Eco-Friendly?

This modern, environmentally conscious calendar offers a unique combination of utility and sustainability. It aligns with the growing demand for green gifts, recycled products, and organic stationery. Whether you are a business looking for corporate sustainable gifts or an individual seeking eco-friendly lifestyle products, this calendar delivers exceptional value and a positive environmental impact.

  • Eco-Friendly Construction: Manufactured using recyclable materials and biodegradable seed paper.
  • 12 Plantable Seed-Paper Sheets (3.5″x5″): Each sheet grows into herbs or flowers when planted.
  • Premium Aesthetic: Features a preserved moss frame on a sturdy 6″x6″ MDF base.
  • Metal Ring Bound: Offers smooth monthly transitions with durable hardware.
  • Instructions Included: Step-by-step guide for planting each seed paper sheet.
  • Ideal for Corporate Gifting: Perfect for eco-friendly gifts, sustainable corporate gifts, and employee welcome kits.
  • Zero Maintenance: Preserved moss never needs watering or sunlight.
  • Environmentally Impactful: Each month promotes planting and supports a greener planet.

Perfect for Personal & Corporate Use

The design enhances any office, home, or gift box with its natural charm. Companies looking to strengthen their sustainability initiatives can use this as a green corporate gift, while eco-conscious customers appreciate its reusable and plantable features. From festive gifting to business promotions, this seed paper calendar reinforces environmental responsibility and brand value.

With its artistic moss frame, compact size, and innovative seed paper feature, this calendar is more than just a date-keeper—it is a daily reminder to live responsibly and make greener choices.
